issues.summary: No row-level shape gate on greenbean rows, asymmetric with the shopify path. weekStartForDate_ (Code.gs:1600) throws RangeError on a missing/malformed dateLocal, and it is first called at orderapp.gs:836 — AFTER ingestSupplierRows has already written to Suppliers (line 808) but BEFORE the resummarize queue is persisted (line 940). A throw there would leave Suppliers holding new money with its affected weeks lost, repeating every run while the failcount alert fires. Currently UNREACHABLE: the producer drops null-dateLocal rows, but only when from/to are supplied (Engine_CostApi.js:544-546), which this collector always sends. Flagged because that safety lives in a separate repo behind a conditional, while the shopify half of the same file does gate its money-bearing fields locally (shopifyValidWeekBody_).

orderAppRunSuccess_ (line 974) stamps the heartbeat and resets the failcount unconditionally, including when remainingQueue.length > 0 — i.e. weeks are knowingly still un-summarized past the GREENBEAN_RESUM_CAP of 5/run. Summary is stale for those weeks and doGet serves the stale figure, but the staleness watchdog sees a healthy heartbeat, so the only signal is a Logger line (line 960) that a trigger-invoked run has no reader for. Self-draining at 5 weeks per weekly run, so the window is bounded, but a large backlog stays invisible for weeks.
